summary: Recent updates in the image decoding section of Firefox have focused on improving how the browser handles different image formats and origins. A significant change is ensuring that service workers, which act as intermediaries for network requests, can manage cross-origin image requests without improperly labeling these responses as insecure, thereby enhancing the security and performance of image loading. This is crucial because it allows for better integration of images from various sources, ultimately leading to a seamless browsing experience. Additionally, some organizational changes were made for easier maintenance of the image decoding code, though these adjustments do not result in direct changes for users.
